traditional: the Moon trine Mars: a soft contact. The body, home, and daily needs supports action, conflict, and heat - cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas.
modern: Emotion meets drive and aggression. Feelings are energized and the instinct is to act on them. The trine makes this a natural strength: Emotional energy fuels getting things done; lively, active imagination. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Feeling and drive flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what feeling and drive have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Drive powered by feeling; the work is managing reactivity.
shadow: The ease lets moodiness and over-need and anger and recklessness go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.

readerCopy.summary: It is much easier to act on what you need when your feelings and your instincts point in the same direction instead of fighting each other for control.
readerCopy.body: It is much easier to act on what you need when your feelings and your instincts point in the same direction instead of fighting each other for control. When the Moon trines Mars, emotional clarity and initiative reinforce each other, making it smooth to speak up, make the call, set a limit, or deal with something you have been putting off before frustration has to become your primary engine. You are less likely to waste hours negotiating with yourself about a move you already know has to happen. Use the clean momentum while it is active.
